title: ESPP Break-Even & Optimal Sell
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #110 (AL-117) ESPP Break-Even & Optimal Sell Analyzer into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. From an ESPP purchase (price paid after the 15% statutory discount, offering-price FMV at grant, current price, shares, grant and purchase dates) and a tax profile (ordinary income, single/MFJ filing, optional as-of date) the node computes the disqualifying and qualifying disposition outcomes side by side: ordinary income (the discount, or its section 423(c)-capped qualifying analog), LTCG tax at the 2026 section 1(h) thresholds layered on ordinary income, the marginal ordinary rate from the 2026 section 1 tables, the break-even qualifying-disposition date (later of grant + 2y + 1d and purchase + 1y + 1d), and after-tax proceeds under each path. Tax constants are Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and IRC 423 fetched-and-quoted in the payload CITES.md. Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/110-espp-break-even-optimal-sell/ fetched 2026-10-08 (sha256 ddccf05f8b1dc1d0a986a6839f7109710a59ea4593fd70c573b5eb00b60fe0e7), tasking APEXPORT-110B (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-13, Builder-verifies-at-land 22/22 vectors / 462 field checks), landed by APEX-PORT-110B-LAND-1 on 2026-10-19.

purchase_price.description: Price actually paid per share after the 15% ESPP discount. Apex control id 'purchasePrice', default 29.75, min 0.01. Read unconditionally by compute().

offering_price.description: FMV at grant / offering start per share. Caps the qualifying-disposition ordinary income (IRC §423(c)). Apex control id 'offeringPrice', default 35.00, min 0.01. Read unconditionally.

current_price.description: Current or expected sale price per share. Apex control id 'currentPrice', default 48.00, min 0.01. Read unconditionally.

shares.description: Shares purchased under the ESPP. Apex control id 'shares', default 500, min 1, step 1. Read unconditionally (Apex parses it with +value, so a fractional value is accepted).

grant_date.description: Grant date / offering start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Apex control id 'grantDate', default 2024-01-01. Read unconditionally (drives the qualifying holding period, IRC §423(a)(1)).

purchase_date.description: Date shares were purchased under the ESPP, YYYY-MM-DD. Apex control id 'purchaseDate', default 2024-07-01. Read unconditionally.

ordinary_income.description: W-2 and other ordinary income for the year, USD. Apex control id 'ordIncome', default 180000, min 0. Read unconditionally; drives the marginal rate and the LTCG bracket layering.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Apex control id 'filingStatus', default 'single' (labelled 'Single / MFS') or 'mfj' ('Married Filing Jointly'). Selects the LTCG thresholds and ordinary-income brackets. Read unconditionally.

as_of_date.description: OPTIONAL YYYY-MM-DD. If supplied, replaces the wall clock for the already_qualified field only, making the payload deterministic. Not read by the Apex page; added by the port so a zkVM-promotable run is reproducible. Not in 'required'.

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_espp_disposition
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare qualifying vs. disqualifying ESPP disposition tax outcomes. Computes ordinary income (the 15% purchase discount), LTCG tax at the 2026 §1(h) rates layered on ordinary income, the marginal ordinary rate, the break-even qualifying-disposition date, and after-tax proceeds under each path. Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

purchase_price.description: Price actually paid per share after the 15% ESPP discount; min 0.01.

offering_price.description: FMV per share at grant / offering start; min 0.01.

current_price.description: Current or sale price per share; min 0.01.

shares.description: Shares purchased under the ESPP; min 1.

ordinary_income.description: W-2 and other ordinary income for the year in USD; min 0.

filing_status.description: Filing status: 'single' (Single / MFS) or 'mfj' (Married Filing Jointly).

as_of_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; fixes already_qualified for a reproducible run.

output_schema.description: output_payload: purchase_price, offering_price, current_price, shares_exercised, grant_date, purchase_date, ordinary_income, filing_status, marginal_rate, fmv_at_purchase, disq_ord_income, disq_ltcg_gain, disq_gross, disq_ord_tax, disq_ltcg_tax, disq_total_tax, disq_proceeds, disq_effective_rate, qual_ord_income, qual_ltcg_gain, qual_gross, qual_ord_tax, qual_ltcg_tax, qual_total_tax, qual_proceeds, qual_effective_rate, benefit, qualify_date, already_qualified.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. as_of_date is the only optional property: it replaces the wall clock for the already_qualified field only, making the payload deterministic; the eight remaining properties are required and mirror the Apex #110 page controls.
author: PostOakLabs
